name: Generate Risk Matrix and Compliance Score for a Grant Proposal

criteria.description: risk_matrix.json file is present in the working directory.
compliance_score.json file is present in the working directory.
risk_matrix.json risks array contains at least 5 risk entries.
Each risk has non-empty string fields for id, description, category, likelihood, impact, mitigation, and owner.
Risks span at least 3 distinct category values (e.g., Operational, Financial, External, Compliance).
At least one risk has likelihood value "High".
compliance_score.json checks array has at least 6 entries each with item, status, and note fields.
compliance score is an integer between 55 and 85 inclusive.
overall_recommendation is one of the valid values: "Go", "Conditional Go", or "No-Go".

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent generated a risk matrix and compliance score for a Nairobi food security grant proposal.

Criterion 1: Risk Realism (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Risks are specific to the project context (food vouchers, community gardens, Nairobi, EU donor) — not generic template risks. Mitigations are actionable and proportional to the likelihood/impact. At least one risk addresses the missing MoU and at least one addresses operational risks for voucher distribution.
0.5: Risks are relevant but mitigations are vague or some risks are too generic to be useful.
0: Risks are generic placeholders or mitigations are absent.

Criterion 2: Compliance Assessment Accuracy (Weight: 40%)
1.0: The checks correctly reflect the stated project context — MoU is flagged as fail, GESI as pass, SDG as pass, sustainability as conditional. The score and recommendation are internally consistent with the check results.
0.5: Checks are present but one or two statuses contradict the project description.
0: Checks ignore the provided context or score is outside the 55-85 range.
eval.name: Quality Judge
